projects.title: Matrix Arithmetic & Statistics Engine
projects.purpose: Master C 2D arrays, pointer arithmetic, manual memory indexing, and struct definitions.

milestones.title: Matrix structure & memory representation
milestones.requirements: Define a Matrix struct with rows, cols, and a flat 1D data array or double pointer.
acceptance_criteria: Encapsulates dimensions safely
Accesses element (r, c) via formula data[r * cols + c]
Compiles cleanly with -Wall -Wextra
milestones.hint: A flat 1D buffer of size rows * cols guarantees contiguous memory layout and better cache locality.

milestones.title: Matrix addition and multiplication
milestones.requirements: Write matrix_add and matrix_multiply functions validating dimension compatibility.
acceptance_criteria: Checks dimension constraints before calculation
Multiplication computes dot products accurately across rows and columns
Returns error code if dimensions mismatch
milestones.hint: Multiplication requires A->cols == B->rows, yielding result of size A->rows x B->cols.

milestones.title: Statistical transformations
milestones.requirements: Calculate determinant (for 2x2 and 3x3), trace, and transpose into a new matrix.
acceptance_criteria: Transpose flips dimensions and elements correctly
Calculates accurate determinant
Handles zero matrix without division by zero errors
milestones.hint: Transpose formula: B->data[c * B->cols + r] = A->data[r * A->cols + c].

extensions: Read matrix data from formatted text file
Implement Gaussian elimination for linear systems
Benchmark cache performance of row-major vs col-major traversal

projects.title: Dynamic Generic Vector Library
projects.purpose: Deep dive into manual dynamic memory allocation: malloc, realloc, free, growth factors, and pointer safety.

milestones.title: Vector lifecycle management
milestones.requirements: Implement vector_create(initial_capacity), vector_free(vec), tracking size and capacity.
acceptance_criteria: malloc allocates buffer and checks for NULL failure
vector_free frees internal buffer and zeroes out struct pointers
No memory leaks under valgrind analysis
milestones.hint: Always test if (vec->data == NULL) handle out-of-memory error.

milestones.title: Geometric reallocation & push_back
milestones.requirements: Implement vector_push(vec, value) that automatically doubles capacity when size == capacity.
acceptance_criteria: Doubles capacity via realloc when limit reached
Preserves original data on reallocation
Guarantees amortized O(1) insertion time
milestones.hint: Use temp = realloc(vec->data, new_cap * sizeof(int)); if (!temp) rollback.

milestones.title: Safe indexing and deletion
milestones.requirements: Implement vector_get, vector_set with bounds checking, and vector_remove_at with memory shifting.
acceptance_criteria: Out of bounds access returns error code or false
Removal shifts subsequent elements with memmove
Size decrements reliably after removal

extensions: Support generic void* elements with custom element size
Implement vector_shrink_to_fit to reclaim unused memory

projects.title: POSIX Micro Unix Shell
projects.purpose: Master systems programming: process management (fork, execvp, waitpid), signal handling, and I/O redirection.

milestones.title: REPL loop & command parsing
milestones.requirements: Read user input line with getline, tokenize arguments using strtok into char* argv[] array.
acceptance_criteria: Handles arbitrary argument count up to MAX_ARGS
Terminates argument array with NULL pointer for execvp
Empty input re-prompts without crashing

milestones.title: Fork & process execution
milestones.requirements: Fork child process to execute commands with execvp, parent waits with waitpid.
acceptance_criteria: Child executes external binaries (ls, pwd, echo)
Parent captures exit status with WIFEXITED and WEXITSTATUS
Handles non-existent commands with descriptive error
milestones.hint: pid_t pid = fork(); if (pid == 0) execvp(args[0], args); else waitpid(pid, &status, 0);

milestones.title: Built-in commands & I/O redirection
milestones.requirements: Implement built-ins (cd, exit) and file redirection (> output.txt) using open and dup2.
acceptance_criteria: cd updates process working directory via chdir()
Redirects stdout to file descriptor when > symbol detected
Restores standard descriptors after execution
milestones.hint: int fd = open(filename, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_TRUNC, 0644); dup2(fd, STDOUT_FILENO); close(fd);

extensions: Handle SIGINT (Ctrl+C) gracefully without killing shell
